blocks.content: The Central Board of Direct Taxes notified the Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers-Disclosure Scheme, 2026, under Chapter IV of the Finance Act, 2026. The scheme provides an online voluntary disclosure window for eligible taxpayers from 16 August 2026 to 31 December 2026.

items: The Central Board of Direct Taxes is the apex direct tax administration body in India under the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance.
The Black Money Act, 2015 deals with undisclosed foreign income and assets held outside India.
Form 1 is the prescribed electronic form for filing declarations under the scheme.
Employee stock option plans are a form of employee compensation linked to company shares.
